judge.rationale: The candidate is an incomplete implementation that stops after only adding validation, leaving its own acceptance tests failing and `.lore/dod.md` committed in the tree. Because `messageHandler.ts` was never updated to handle the new union member on `IncomingMessage` or wire up the store, the feature does not work at all and `conversationList.acceptance.test.ts` fails. Furthermore, the candidate invented the wrong protocol and type names (`list_sessions` / `session_list` / `ListSessionsMessage` instead of `list_conversations` / `conversation_list` / `ListConversationsMessage`), allowed `limit: 0` and unbounded limits instead of restricting to 1–200, and planned to return an empty list when `listFor` is missing rather than `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED`. It also completely omitted `HalEngineConfig.transport.history`, `StoreCannotList`, `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED`, the protocol spec updates, and the `example/full-config.ts` / `docs/getting-started.md` changes.
